notes: Require a confirmed Linux shell and Docker CLI before using these POSIX commands.
Check the active Docker context before assuming a daemon is local. Access denied is not evidence of stopped containers.

For a confirmed container, use timeout 15s docker logs --since 15m --tail 100 --timestamps CONTAINER 2>&1 | head -c 32768, with the observed container name safely shell-quoted. Never use --follow or an unbounded history scan.
Do not dump docker inspect environment fields or compose config: they can contain credentials.
Inspection does not authorize exec, restart, stop, rm, prune, pull, or compose up. Ask before any change.
